mentions.name: Phrasing
mentions.description: A language learning and acquisition tool for polyglots supporting 120+ languages. The author uses it to study roughly a dozen languages at once (five in maintenance, two seriously, five casually) and is seeking beta testers who are learning or maintaining multiple languages.
mentions.audience: Polyglots and anyone learning or maintaining several languages; the author is looking for beta testers in as many languages as possible.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been working on http://phrasing.app - a language learning & acquisition tool for polyglots.
